data.narrative:
Aeon Industrial is a Seed-stage defense and security company founded by Naweed Tahmas and Joe Cieslik that has raised $18.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms—spanning the same sector and stage, including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $18.6M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $46.5M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Stark Defence at $4.0B, UFORCE at $1.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M), producing a median valuation of $1.0B. The peer range spans $125M to $4.0B, reflecting heterogeneity within early-stage defense tech.

The triangulated valuation range is $40M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $523M. The wide dispersion reflects acute uncertainty around Aeon's technology differentiation, addressable market capture, and near-term revenue trajectory relative to the peer set. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median estimates warrants scrutiny of whether Aeon's capability set justifies defense-sector valuation multiples or whether more conservative Seed-stage multiples better reflect execution risk.
